evals.prompt: Build me a settings page for my app: profile name and email, a notifications section with a few toggles, and a danger zone where I can delete my account. Keep it simple.
evals.expected_output: A settings page built from system components with grouped sections, one primary Save, toggles that give feedback, and a confirmed, undoable or alert-dialog-guarded delete.
